verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents "Private Storage on Enterprise to store your meeting data at your preferred location" and "Secure, dedicated cloud storage exclusively for your organization's data," indicating data residency choice is offered, but only as an Enterprise-tier add-on with no detail on specific regions/countries available or how selection is configured. Missing for 10: list of supported regions/jurisdictions, self-serve UI/API to select region, independent verification of residency enforcement.
